title: A Patient World Model for Early Forecasting of Digital Health Campaign Outcomes: Capabilities and Limits
abstract: arXiv:2609.23333v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Digital direct-to-consumer (DTC) health campaigns are usually measured after the fact. In-flight forecasting commonly relies on a separate classifier for every cutoff and horizon. We treat this task as a dynamic-system problem and build a compact patient world model. The architecture maintains a latent state per patient, learns exposure-conditioned state dynamics jointly with a weekly conversion hazard, and rolls forward into future conversion curves. We evaluate it on a US campaign dataset with 147{,}173 patients and 5.2 million at-risk person-weeks. In a retrospective evaluation conditioned on recorded future exposures, the model forecasts the remaining new-to-brand prescription volume through week 52 with a relative error of 2.9\% from a week-4 cutoff and 0.8--2.6\% from cutoffs at weeks 8--26. translated_title: 用于数字健康营销活动结果早期预测的患者世界模型：能力与局限
translated_abstract: 数字直接面向消费者（DTC）健康营销活动通常是在事后才进行衡量，而活动进行中的预测通常依赖于针对每个截断点和预测时间范围的独立分类器。我们将这一任务视为动态系统问题，并构建了一个紧凑的患者世界模型。该架构为每位患者维护一个潜在状态，将暴露条件下的状态动力学与每周转化风险进行联合学习，并向前滚动以预测未来的转化曲线。我们在一个包含147,173名患者和520万风险人周的美国营销活动数据集上对该模型进行了评估。在以记录的未来暴露为条件的回顾性评估中，该模型从第4周截断点预测截至第52周的剩余新品牌处方量，相对误差仅为2.9%；从第8至26周的截断点预测，相对误差为0.8%–2.6%。最强的非循环基线模型——即在相同生存滚动和信息条件下运行的合并风险梯度提升模型——相对误差……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种患者世界模型，将数字健康营销活动的早期结果预测视为动态系统问题，通过为每位患者维护潜在状态并联合学习暴露条件下的状态动力学与每周转化风险，实现了从第4周截断点以仅2.9%的相对误差预测至第52周剩余新品牌处方量的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a patient world model that treats early forecasting of digital health campaign outcomes as a dynamic-system problem, maintaining per-patient latent states and jointly learning exposure-conditioned dynamics with weekly conversion hazards, achieving only 2.9% relative error in forecasting remaining new-to-brand prescription volume through week 52 from a week-4 cutoff.
